title: Repeated configuration lookup per request
summary: Request handlers repeatedly load configuration, secrets, or environment-dependent metadata.
rationale: Configuration and secret retrieval in hot paths creates unnecessary latency and external service load.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Load stable configuration once, cache secret lookups safely, and refresh through explicit lifecycle hooks.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
